param_reference.locations: optional country/region filter, e.g. India, Worldwide

extract_js: Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('a[href*="/company/"]')).map(a => ({ href: a.href.split('?')[0], title: a.innerText?.slice(0, 120) || '' })).filter(x => /\/company\/[^/]+\/jobs\//.test(x.href)).reduce((acc, x) => { if (!acc.find(y => y.href === x.href)) acc.push(x); return acc; }, []).slice(0, 20)
rules: Substitute {KEYWORD} with URL-encoded role (+ for spaces), one keyword group per URL
All listings are remote by default — add locations= only when prompt restricts region
Some listings link out to company ATS — column C should be the final apply URL after verification
Verify finalists with WebFetch; site is WebFetch-friendly (no login wall)
notes: Seeded 2026-08-20 — search URL pattern verified live (jobTitle/page/sort params)
Patch extract_js on first run if selector drift
Aggregator: 190k+ jobs, claims many not on LinkedIn — good LinkedIn complement
